title: J. J. O’Molloy
html_source:
A solicitor down on his luck – Gifford, Ulysses Annotated.

Another of the crew assembles in the galleys of the paper – quite an assortment: Ned Lambert, JJ O'Molloy, Simon Dedalus and MacHugh.
